user.title: Polyglot Assist
user.description:
Multi-language Tier-1 conversation agent.

Pick an LLM agent to receive unmatched utterances. The intents file is read from `/config/{intents_default}` and reloadable via the `polyglot_assist.reload` service.

error.intents_not_found: Intents file not found at the given path.
error.intents_invalid: Intents file failed validation. Check the log for details.
error.fallback_is_polyglot: Polyglot cannot be its own fallback (that would be an endless loop). Choose your AI assistant or the Home Assistant agent.

init.title: Polyglot Assist
init.description: What would you like to do?

change_fallback.title: Fallback conversation agent
change_fallback.description: Pick the agent that receives utterances Polyglot did not match.

language_hint.title: Fallback language hint
language_hint.description: When on, unmatched utterances that are clearly in another configured language (de/en/fr word lists) get a short instruction for the fallback agent to reply in that language. Off by default; the input is otherwise passed on unchanged.

data.fallback_language_hint: Ask the fallback agent to reply in the detected language

edit_visual.title: Choose an intent to edit
edit_visual.description: Pick the intent whose sentences you want to edit.

edit_intent.title: Edit intent: {intent_name}
edit_intent.description: Edit per-language sentences (one per line). Languages already defined: {existing_langs}. To add another language, pick its code below and save — an empty bucket appears for it.

data.response_intent: Target intent_script name (HA intent to dispatch to)

edit_yaml.title: Edit intents.yaml
edit_yaml.description: Edit the raw YAML for /config/polyglot_assist/intents.yaml. Validated on save — if YAML is malformed, no write happens.

add_intent.title: Add a new intent
add_intent.description: Create a new intent. After save, you can add sentences in the visual editor.

reload.title: Reload matcher
reload.description: Rebuild the Hassil matcher from the on-disk intents.yaml. Useful after editing the file externally.

chat_log.title: Hits in conversation history
chat_log.description: When on, a Polyglot hit whose intent declares `llm_equivalent` is added to the conversation history as a call of a tool your fallback agent really has (read from its settings), so follow-ups like "and the piano too" work. Intents without a matching tool are never recorded.

source.title: Intents source
source.description: YAML file (default) or catalog in Home Assistant's storage. The first switch to the catalog copies intents.yaml 1:1 (checked before writing). If both differ you decide; the side that is replaced is exported to polyglot_assist/export/ first. {err}

data.when_different: If YAML file and catalog differ

translation.title: Translation proposals
translation.description: AI Task entity that proposes sentences and names for other languages. Proposals are checked and only applied when you accept them. AI tasks with tools (an LLM API) are not allowed: sentences and device names are untrusted text for the model. Sentences and names are sent to this AI task — with a cloud provider they leave your home.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The languages spoken in your home. Polyglot only listens for sentences in these languages.

answers.title: Answer to commands
answers.description: Speech: e.g. "Couch light on." Tone: a short sound instead (needs Polyglot TTS; with other TTS engines choose Speech). Only for commands marked as switching commands; questions are always spoken.

monitor.title: Voice-flow monitoring
monitor.description: Polyglot keeps the last 500 voice requests (text only, no audio; stays in Home Assistant). Once a day your AI task (the one chosen for proposals, without tools) looks for sentences that often needed the assistant, and puts proposals into the proposal list. Nothing changes without you accepting it.

error.invalid_yaml: YAML failed to parse: {err}. Fix the syntax and save again.
error.invalid_name: Intent name must be alphanumeric with optional underscores.
error.name_exists: An intent with that name already exists.
error.sources_differ: YAML file and catalog differ. Choose what to do with the differences below.
error.ai_task_has_tools: This AI task has tools (an LLM API). Choose one without tools.
error.fallback_is_polyglot: Polyglot cannot be its own fallback (that would be an endless loop). Choose your AI assistant or the Home Assistant agent.

abort.no_intents: No intents found in the file. Use 'Add a new intent' to create one.

reload.name: Reload intents
reload.description: Rebuild the multi-language Hassil matcher from the configured intents file.

test_match.name: Test match
test_match.description: Run a string through the matcher without dispatching.

run_tests.name: Run regression corpus
run_tests.description: Match every sentence of a corpus file and report failures. Nothing is executed. Admin only.

file.name: Corpus file
file.description: YAML file below the polyglot_assist folder of the config directory (default polyglot_assist/tests.yaml).

language.name: Language hint
language.description: Pipeline language passed to the matcher like at runtime.

import_yaml.name: Import intents.yaml into the catalog
import_yaml.description: Copies the YAML file 1:1 into the catalog (.storage) and verifies the round-trip. Does not switch the source. Admin only.

overwrite.name: Overwrite active catalog
overwrite.description: Replace the catalog even while it is the active source (it is exported first).

export_yaml.name: Export catalog to YAML
export_yaml.description: Writes the catalog to polyglot_assist/export/intents-TIMESTAMP.yaml. Admin only.

options.use_yaml: Use the YAML file (export the catalog first)
options.keep_other: Keep the target as it is (export the catalog when leaving it)

load_failed.title: Polyglot Assist could not load its intents
load_failed.description: Source: {source}. Error: {error}. Open the integration options → Intents source to switch to the other source, or restore the file. Polyglot does not fall back on its own, so intents you disabled stay disabled.
